info.title: Cooper Waters API
info.description: Phase 1 REST API. Money is integer toea (1 PGK = 100 toea). Times are UTC ISO-8601.

token.description: FCM registration token; null/empty to unregister.

notes.description: Landmark directions — most PNG addresses are landmark-based.

locationId.description: A saved location; or send `location` instead.

msisdn.description: Cell money number to charge (defaults to the account phone).

at.description: ISO time the fix was taken (for batched uploads).

proofPhotoKey.description: Optional proof-of-delivery photo key from POST /driver/uploads.

referenceText.description: Bank transfer: the bank's transaction reference.

destination.description: Cell money number or bank account details.

driverId.description: Assign directly to this driver; omit to release the order back to dispatch.

value.description: Any JSON value (number, string, boolean or list)

amountToea.description: Signed toea: positive credits the wallet, negative debits it.

receiptRef.description: Receipt / transaction id seen in the merchant account.

refundToea.description: favour_customer only; defaults to the full order price.

phone.description: Phone number; PNG numbers may omit +675.

app.description: Which app is signing in; decides the role on first registration.
